notes:
Read the full 37-line numbered source before editing. Covered: LogoProps interface with size?/showWordmark?/className? (L1-5); the default export `Logo` with destructured defaults size=32, showWordmark=false, className='' (L7); the per-instance random gradient id `lg-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}` (L8); the wrapper
(L10); the close (L29); the {showWordmark && (...)} guarded wordmark TeslaSync (L30-34); and the
/ return / function close (L35-37).

Mapped web->native primitives (react-native-svg is NOT a dependency, verified absent from package.json + node_modules): wrapper <div> flex items-center gap-2.5 -> <View> styles.root (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap 10); <svg> sized to {size} with shrink-0 -> square badge <View> (width/height = size, flexShrink 0); rect rx40 on a 0..200 viewBox -> borderRadius = size * 0.2 (40/200); the wordmark <span> font-bold/text-sm/tracking-tight/text-[var(--text-primary)] -> <AppText tone='primary'> at fontSize 14, fontWeight '700', letterSpacing -0.3, lineHeight 20, gated on showWordmark exactly as L30. size=32 + showWordmark=false defaults preserved; the literal brand string 'TeslaSync' kept verbatim (proper noun, not i18n). Default export preserved AND a named `export function Logo` + Logo.displayName='Logo' added to match the native parity convention. className accepted-but-ignored; style/testID added for native call-sites. No DOM/SVG/Recharts/Leaflet/web-ui imports used.

Native-unavailable browser behavior reimplemented + documented: the <linearGradient> diagonal --theme-primary->--theme-accent fill has no React Native core primitive and no gradient package is installed, so it is approximated by a solid badge fill of the start stop THEME_PRIMARY (#00f0ff); the accent stop (#10b981) cannot be painted without a gradient layer and both literals are pinned from the source CSS-var fallbacks because native has no CSS custom-property theming. The bolt <path fill='currentColor'> -> a white high-voltage glyph '\u26A1\uFE0E' (U+FE0E text-presentation selector forces colorable text over a yellow emoji); currentColor inheritance has no RN analog so the documented 'White bolt' intent is pinned to #ffffff and marked accessible={false} as decorative. The random gradient id (L8) only namespaced the SVG <linearGradient>/url(#...) reference to avoid cross-instance collisions; there is no <defs>/url() on native, so it is intentionally dropped.
